command.$interpolate: capcli ping notify {{principal}} "Nightly sync finished" --channel slack --intent "morning briefing"
command.$example: capcli ping notify user:bob "Nightly sync finished" --channel slack --intent "morning briefing"

culprit.$interpolate: Principal '{{principal}}' not found in the agents registry.
culprit.$example: Principal 'user:bob' not found in the agents registry.

component.remedy: register the recipient first (capcli sys agent register), or notify an existing principal such as user:root
